description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode to display log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data, converts log levels to readable strings, and appends log entries to the UI, supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, with methods to format and display log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, then appends it to the LogView and passes it to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
